description: Conceptual schema for a proposed agent action submitted to KATA for pre-execution evaluation, including price integrity and the counterparty. Status: Concept / Open Design — not production ready.

action_id.description: Unique identifier for this proposed action.

action_type.description: The kind of action: purchase, transfer, payment, account_creation, password_reset, data_access, api_invocation, contract_acceptance, booking, investment, communication, privilege_escalation, etc.

agent_spend_baseline.description: This agent's own typical spend. Complements the user-declared intent maximum_amount: the same amount can be over-limit for one agent and ordinary for another. It does not show that a genuine merchant charged above its own list price.

basis.description: How the baseline was formed, e.g. per_agent_observed.

typical_amount.description: Typical amount for this agent, in currency.

amount.description: Monetary amount, if the action involves money.

context.description: Surrounding context: merchant, counterparty, session metadata.

counterparty.description: The merchant or other payee. Identity, domain, and settlement address can all be genuine while the charge is not.

domain.description: Merchant domain or host the agent believes it is paying.

registered_settlement_address.description: Settlement or payee address on file for this merchant.

reputation.description: Prior counterparty reputation. A high score does not clear the current charge.

risk.description: Coarse risk band from prior evidence.

settlement_address.description: Address or payee identifier that would receive the funds for this action.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, when an amount is present.

item.description: Human-readable description of what the action targets.

price.description: Quote, list, peer reference, fees, and final charge. Compare them with a tolerance band. Equality is the wrong test: legitimate prices move, and overcharge overlaps that movement.

charged_amount.description: Final amount taken or proposed to be taken. When both are set, this agrees with the action amount.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the amounts in this object.

expected_price.description: Price the evaluator expected when it differs from the quote and the list, such as a mandate total.

fee_breakdown.description: Line items that sum toward the charge, each marked disclosed or not.

amount.description: Line amount in the action currency.

code.description: Line role, e.g. item, tax, shipping, service_fee.

disclosed.description: True when this line was shown before commitment.

listed_price.description: Catalogue or advertised price for this item or service.

peer_price.description: What other buyers pay for the same service, when an external reference exists. The buyer's own history is the wrong baseline for price discrimination.

proposed_at.description: When the agent proposed this action.

service.description: Quoted tier versus delivered tier. Silent downgrade is full price for a cheaper tier. The agent often cannot observe delivery; a missing delivered_tier is missing evidence, not a pass.

delivered_tier.description: Tier actually delivered, when fulfillment evidence exists.

description.description: What the service or item is.

session_id.description: The agent session this action belongs to.

settlement.description: Settlement state for this attempt. A prior status of failed, with a new idempotency key, is an ordinary retry. Retry farming is a prior attempt that settled, was reported as failed, and is charged again.

failure_reason.description: Why the prior or current attempt failed, when known.

prior_attempt_status.description: Outcome of the previous attempt, if this action is a retry.

prior_idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key of the previous attempt.

title: KATA Action
